product_joins.semantic_mismatch_warning: WMS UPC is a standard 12-digit barcode; Portal mfr_code is an internal alphanumeric product code (e.g. SD-IONST-PRK). They CANNOT be joined directly without a crosswalk!

order_joins.formatting_rule: portal_db uses 'SO-41234' with hyphen; wms_db uses 'SO41234' without hyphen. Stripping hyphens achieves 100% resolution.

entity_separation.identity_rule: Members are independent consumers (Gmail, Yahoo, Outlook, iCloud). Partners are B2B entities with business names. Automatic email domain merging would corrupt entity boundaries.
